document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
A  gigantic  hairy  shape  shuffles  out  before  you.  At  first, 
you  mistake  it  for  a  gorilla—but  at  second  glance,  your 
anthropologist’s eye marks it as a species never before described 
scientifically. The appropriate action here is to offer it food as a 
gesture of friendship.
Make a Luck roll: if you succeed, go to 419; if you fail, go to 325.
